about.heading: About
about.lead: A product-minded full-stack profile able to move from business need to final experience.
about.statement: I build web products that must convince users and hold up in production.
about.text: Fullstack developer in a work-study program at 1UP, I started coding self-taught through The Odin Project before completing certified training at Simplon in web development and then application design. Currently pursuing a Master's in Software Engineering at ISCOD, I work daily on Odoo and Symfony projects. What I love about this field is the continuous problem-solving and the richness of the web — there's always something new to learn.
about.card1Desc: I start from the real need, clarify the expected use, and connect each technical decision to a useful outcome for the people concerned.
about.card2Desc: I favor readable, testable, and documented foundations so products remain understandable as they evolve.
about.card3Desc: I automate deterministic tasks, measure the effects achieved, and preserve human judgment wherever it adds value.

skills.heading: Skills
skills.subtext: Six broad areas summarize my daily practice. The comparison and all ten detailed skills remain available on the dedicated page.
skills.backendDesc: Application architecture, business logic, APIs, and data with reliability as the baseline.
skills.frontendDesc: Next.js/React interfaces with typography, responsiveness, motion, and sharp details.
skills.odooDesc: Custom modules, migrations, views, models, integrations, and ERP workflow understanding.
skills.devopsDesc: Deployment, databases, containers, VPS operations, and tooling to keep releases clean.
skills.methodsDesc: Requirement discovery, iteration, documentation, code review, and communication with business profiles.
skills.educationDesc: Algorithmic foundations, design, project practice, and continuous growth in software engineering.

featuredProjects.heading: Achievements connecting product standards and technical execution.
featuredProjects.text: A short selection of achievements framed as concrete proof: critical migration, business modules, showcase redesign, and user impact.

cases.problem: Move a critical ERP across three major releases without lasting disruption to work or loss of data.
cases.contribution: Inventory, module-by-module strategy, migration rehearsals, testing, cutover, and stabilization managed autonomously.
cases.result: Odoo 16 → 19 · 19 direct users · no permanent data loss · stabilized within one month.
cases.metricNote: No permanent data loss and stabilization within one month.

cases.problem: Important business processes remained manual or exceeded the limits of standard configuration and Odoo Studio.
cases.contribution: Requirement discovery, Python/XML design, testing, deployment, and maintenance of a version-controlled business layer in the ERP.
cases.result: 16 internal business modules · half a working day saved every week for accounting.
cases.metricNote: Half a working day saved every week for accounting.

cases.problem: Modernize the company image without sacrificing mobile quality, performance, or control over published content.
cases.contribution: Technical ownership, Next.js architecture, design system, internationalization, SEO, accessibility, and coordination of approvals.
cases.result: Measured Lighthouse: 99 performance, 100 accessibility, and 100 SEO.
cases.metricNote: 100 accessibility and 100 SEO in the published measurement.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.subtext: A practice-built trajectory: self-learning, university research, business software, ERP, e-commerce, and showcase websites.

entries.title: Fullstack Developer — Work-Study
entries.description: Development and maintenance of Odoo modules (Python, PostgreSQL). Design and development of a B2B e-commerce site with Symfony. Corporate website redesign with Next.js. Solo management of Odoo v16 → v19 migration. Database administration, CI/CD and VPS server management (OVH, Digital Ocean).
responsibilities: Technical owner for internal Odoo business developments.
Autonomous management of the Odoo v16 → v19 ERP migration.
Fullstack development across ERP, B2B e-commerce, corporate website and infrastructure.

entries.title: Web Developer Intern — LIG Lab
entries.description: Development of a Vue.js and D3.js application for a sociological study questionnaire on life trajectories. Custom data visualization creation. Collaboration with university researchers.
responsibilities: Design and development of a first functional version of the application.
Implementation of D3.js visualizations tailored to research needs.
Translation of sociological needs into usable interfaces and data models.

entries.title: Master's in Software Engineering — RNCP level 7
entries.description: Level 7 work-study program covering software architecture, project steering, quality, deployment, and application integration through real professional situations.
entries.institutions: ISCOD combines remote learning with work-study experience. This format makes it possible to confront academic concepts with technical decisions made in the workplace and to document skills through verifiable achievements.
responsibilities: Connect the certification skill blocks to assignments completed in the workplace.
Deepen software architecture, project management, and quality practices.
Build and defend a portfolio of professional evidence.

entries.title: TOEIC Listening & Reading — 920/990
entries.description: TOEIC Listening & Reading score of 920/990: C1 level in listening comprehension and B2 level in reading comprehension.
entries.institutions: The TOEIC measures English comprehension in international professional situations. The public certificate lets reviewers verify the date, overall score, and achieved levels directly.

entries.title: Application Designer & Developer — RNCP level 6
entries.description: Level 6 professional certification focused on application design and development, databases, modeling, testing, and software project delivery.
entries.institutions: Simplon uses active learning through practice, projects inspired by professional situations, and small-group work. The program strengthened my ability to turn a need into a structured, tested, and documented application.
responsibilities: Design an application architecture and model its data.
Develop, test, and document a fullstack application.
Present technical choices and achieved results.

entries.title: Web and Mobile Web Developer — RNCP level 5
entries.description: Level 5 professional certification covering interface integration, frontend and backend development, databases, and web application deployment.
entries.institutions: Simplon's project-based pedagogy turned a self-taught practice, notably built with The Odin Project, into a professional method: analyze, build, test, document, and present a usable solution.
responsibilities: Develop responsive and accessible web interfaces.
Build server-side logic connected to a database.
Version, deploy, and present completed projects.

Form security: IP address, timestamp, and reCAPTCHA token when the service is configured

privacy.purposeText: Contact-form processing relies on the legitimate interest of answering received requests and protecting the website against spam. Data is available to the site publisher and to providers strictly required for operation, including Vercel for hosting and Resend for email delivery. It is never sold. Messages are kept for the time required to follow up on a request and deleted no later than twelve months after the last exchange, unless a legal obligation requires otherwise.

Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics load only after explicit consent, which can be withdrawn at any time through the “Manage cookies” link in the footer. reCAPTCHA can load only after an interaction with the contact form when that service is configured.

To exercise these rights, use the address listed in the legal notice. You may also lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, the CNIL.
